sources.title: Wearable Activity Dataset ⌚ — Fitness & Health Tracking Data
sources.snippet: This dataset contains wearable fitness and biometric data, modeled on devices like the Apple Watch. All entries are synthetic, privacy-safe, and ready for ML pipelines. Suitable for predictive modeling, activity classification, and LLM-based experiments.

sources.title: Machine learning models for wearable-based human activity recognition ...
sources.snippet: Network architectures in combination with wearable devices enable applications, such as remote monitoring, accident prevention, and rehabilitation support. However, real-world implementation remains hindered by challenges such as sensor configuration and placement, model complexity, and the generalizability across different activity types.

sources.title: On-Device Activity Classification Micro-AI - GitHub
sources.snippet: This example simulates a 'Micro-AI' application running on a resource-constrained consumer device, such as a fitness tracker. It demonstrates how sensor data is processed locally using a lightweight model to classify activity levels (sedentary, walking, running) without sending any data to a cloud server. This approach ensures low latency, enhanced data privacy, and reduced operational costs ...
